description: This Java class defines the 'Image' entity for the domain model, representing images stored in the system with attributes like location and storage type. It is mapped to the 'm_image' database table and extends an abstract persistable class, providing getters and setters for its properties.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Entity class representing an image with location and storage type attributes, mapped to the 'm_image' table.

methods.name: Image
methods.description: Constructor to create an Image instance with specified location and storage type.

methods.description: Returns the location of the image.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type integer value.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location of the image.

methods.name: setStorageType
methods.description: Sets the storage type of the image.
